Autograder prototype — third-party components

MLC WebLLM 0.2.86 (Apache-2.0)
https://github.com/mlc-ai/web-llm
The bundled browser runtime retains dependency license notices at the end of
dist/vendor/webllm.js. Full license: dist/vendor/WEBLLM-LICENSE.txt

Qwen3-4B (Apache-2.0), locally fine-tuned with synthetic case examples
https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-4B
The deployed weights contain the synthetic-case fine-tune. The model license
and training/export reports accompany the static model assets.
The MLC browser runtime is retained for reproducibility and is no longer loaded
by the student interface. Hosted inference uses the pinned FP16 base and adapter.
https://huggingface.co/mlc-ai/Qwen3-4B-q4f16_1-MLC

Pyodide 0.27.7 / CPython
https://pyodide.org/
The unmodified Python WebAssembly runtime is fetched from its public CDN.
Pyodide and CPython retain their upstream licenses. No Python runtime binary
is redistributed inside this site archive.

esbuild 0.25.12 (MIT) is a build-time dependency; no esbuild runtime is
deployed. Its package retains its upstream license in node_modules.

Original Excel case, VBA and grading scripts: existing project authors.
Those materials retain their existing ownership and distribution permissions.
Including the user's code for this prototype assigns no new public license.

Gradio JavaScript Client 2.7.1 (Apache-2.0)
https://github.com/gradio-app/gradio
Bundled as dist/vendor/gradio.js. License: dist/vendor/GRADIO-CLIENT-LICENSE.txt
The public client calls the hosted feedback service without an API key.
